case_title: LEIGH FRAZIER VS. NEIMAN MARCUS GROUP LLC ET AL

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-08-2022 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF FRAZIER, LEIGH IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT NEIMAN MARCUS GROUP LLC PEREZTERAN, CLEMENTINA NOTHING. PLAINTIFF DID NOT PROVE HER CASE BY A PREPONDERANCE OF THE EVIDENCE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE FEE $165) SERVED OCT-27-2022, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT PEREZTERAN, CLEMENTINA
STIPULATION TO ALLOW THE CASE TO BE HEARD BY A JUDGE PRO TEM. JOSEPH NOVELLI, LOSS PROTECTION MANAGER FILED BY FRAZIER, LEIGH NEIMAN MARCUS GROUP LLC
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) FILED BY DEFENDANT NEIMAN MARCUS GROUP LLC

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF DEC-08-2022 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF DEC-08-2022 BY VISITING JUDGE. PLAINTIFF LEIGH FRAZIER IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT NIEMAN MARCUS GROUP LLC IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY JOSEPH NOVELLI, LOSS PREVENTION MANAGER. DEFENDANT CLEMENTINA PREZETERAN IS NOT PRESENT. PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON BOTH DEFENDANTS. PARTIES STIPULATED TO JPT. JPT GROVER GAVE DISCLOSURE OF HIS PREVIOUS LEGAL WORK (ALMOST 20 YEARS PRIOR)WITH NEIMAN MARCUS GROUP. PARTIES HAVE NOT OBJECTIONS. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. COURT RECESSES AT 9:30 ANDL RESUMED AT 1:30 TO ALLOW THE COURT TO REVIEW VIDEO EXHIBIT IN CHAMBERS (PARTIES DO NOT OBJECT). THE COURT ALLOWS THE PLAINTIFF TO REIVEW VIDEOS AND RESPOND BEFORE MATTER IS TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION. THE COURT ASKS DEFENDANT TO SUPPLY THE PLAINTIFF WITH A COPY OF THE VIDEOS WHICH WERE REVIEWED PREVIOULY BY ALL PARTIES. JUDGE PRO TEM: ERIC GROVER; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)

SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF FRAZIER, LEIGH AS TO DEFENDANT NEIMAN MARCUS GROUP LLC
